_doc: One switch for every origin / disclosure line about the demo characters (Lumi, Mio, Ren). The project's choice, pending: 'rebuild' (the look is being rebuilt from text with open models) or 'disclose' (keep the current look and say how it was made). Switch with: .venv/bin/python scripts/set_character_origin.py disclose (or rebuild), then commit. The files it rewrites are listed in opensoul/character_origin.py.

lumi_origin.rebuild: Original AI character (no photo of any person; not based on any existing anime or game character). Her current v3 look descends from a concept image made with a closed (non-open) image generator (concepts/lumi_real_B.jpg); the v3 sheet, references, start frames and the demo film's stills come from it. It is being replaced by a text-only rebuild with open models. The v1 files (lumi_ref_00.jpg, lumi_character_sheet_v1.jpg, lumi_still_01.jpg) were drawn from text with open models (workflow 07t).
lumi_origin.disclose: Original AI character (no photo of any person; not based on any existing anime or game character). Her current v3 look was made from a concept image by a closed (non-open) image generator (concepts/lumi_real_B.jpg); the v3 sheet, references, start frames and the demo film's stills come from it. The v1 files (lumi_ref_00.jpg, lumi_character_sheet_v1.jpg, lumi_still_01.jpg) were drawn from text with open models (workflow 07t).

couple_origin.rebuild: Original AI character (no photo of any person). The look was developed from couple concept images made with a closed (non-open) image generator; it is being replaced by a text-only rebuild with open models. No name, outfit, prop, pose or line from any existing work is used.
couple_origin.disclose: Original AI character (no photo of any person). The current look was made from couple concept images by a closed (non-open) image generator. No name, outfit, prop, pose or line from any existing work is used.
